## Changed queue context and lost-decision reconciliation
`src/screens/LabVerification.tsx`, `src/lab-verification-policy.ts`, generated types/bundle/help/FAQs and tests. Structural AST audit confirms only VerificationItemOut adds requisition_id/number,patient_id,barcode,entered_by,due_at,is_overdue; every other declaration/function unchanged. Each row opens its OWN order ID, no patient-name binding or manual queue workaround. Compare author stable ID with current auth/me user_id, including fresh auth preflight; names never identity. Display server due_at/nullunknown; server is_overdue alone controls optional500char reason. No client deadline calculation.

Fresh sandbox two rows for LR1 have all seven fields, actual author21 (auth/me), barcode, deadline and is_overdue=false. Actual Electron Inspect opens row order directly. Verifier22 CBCresult1 verify200 intentionally lost and RBSresult2 reject200 intentionally lost: ONEPOST each under doubleclick; dialog/navigation locked, no retry. Read original frozen req1 finds exact result/item/patient: Published+verified_stamp or Rejected displayed, deliberate reviewed return. Fresh server read confirms both. Resumed after test-selector diagnostic ONLY after reconciling Published; never repeated it.

Unit tests exercise own/different IDs with duplicate names, changed context, missing/wrong order/patient/result/item, Published/Rejected/PendingVerification, note/reason bounds and optional late reason. PendingVerification offers fresh review; absent exact result remains locked; never queue-absence success. Live rows were on time: actual late prompt and combined-role refusal remain a named human manual check, not claimed as live-tested. No q:tested or human acceptance claimed.

## Changed counted-label and worklist behaviour
`src/screens/LabBench.tsx`, `electron/main.cjs`, generated/bundle/help/policy tests and fresh DEV scripts. Audited EVERY frontend label path: one explicit Print/Save action; generated helper unused. No mount/preview/effect/refetch calls. Central transport excludes counted GET from network and token automatic replay; UI synchronous latch handles double clicks. Collect answer supplies first display; print answer supplies later display even on native printer failure. Server count only, clinical version preflight retained.
